title: Finite bit random streams and variate generation

items.title: Linear congruential generator modulo a power of two
items.strategy: Define the exact finite-state recurrence and midpoint output; leave full-period correctness to a separate theorem.

items.title: Counter stream from a keyed finite permutation
items.strategy: Define a deterministic key/counter interface with exhaustion; make no independence or cryptographic claim.

items.title: Every deterministic finite-state stream is eventually periodic
items.strategy: Use the pigeonhole principle, and show a bijective transition has no preperiod.

items.title: Disjoint streams of independent fair bits produce independent uniform variables
items.strategy: Construct the countable product under CC and DC, prove dyadic CDFs, and extend finite-prefix factorization to full stream independence.

items.title: Generalized inverse sublevel identity for a CDF
items.strategy: Use monotonicity, right continuity, tail limits, and the infimum property; do not use the published quantile example as a supplier.

items.title: Box–Muller has a product Gaussian density and Rayleigh second moment
items.strategy: Derive the radial and angular laws, apply the actual C1 polar substitution, factor the density, and compute the second radial moment.

items.title: Midpoint bit discretization has bounded coupling and CDF error
items.strategy: Couple the infinite bit expansion to the midpoint of its first b bits; derive W1, Kolmogorov, and total-variation claims.

items.title: The power-of-two mixed LCG has full period but dependent adjacent states
items.strategy: Induct on powers of two using affine iterates, then count the graph support under a uniform seed.

items.title: A keyed permutation stream does not reuse outputs before its counter interval ends
items.strategy: Injectivity of each fixed-key permutation gives exact no-reuse on distinct counters, without a stochastic-independence claim.

items.title: Unbiased rational Bernoulli sampling by bit rejection
items.strategy: Draw k-bit integers, reject values outside the denominator range, and distinguish capped inconclusive status from successful output.

items.title: Finite categorical sampling by inverse CDF and binary search
items.strategy: Binary-search cumulative masses with ideal U or midpoint U_b and expose exact comparison and endpoint rules.

items.title: Certified bracketed bisection for a continuous CDF
items.strategy: Run a fixed number of bisections from a certified CDF-oscillation modulus; return explicit tail, precision, and budget statuses.

items.title: Disjoint ideal fair-bit streams yield independent standard normals by Box–Muller
items.strategy: Combine the product-law transform theorem with the bit-stream theorem, and use AC only to identify the canonical published N(0,1) notation.

items.title: Rational Bernoulli rejection has exact law, geometric failure, and bounded expected bit cost
items.strategy: Sum the first-accepted-attempt probabilities and the geometric tail; retain inconclusive status at finite budgets.

items.title: Midpoint categorical frequencies have at most one-grid-cell error
items.strategy: Round each cumulative threshold to its exact midpoint-grid count, then subtract adjacent cumulative errors.

items.title: Certified bisection controls CDF residual, spatial error, and distribution error
items.strategy: Prove bracket invariants and residual, use a positive density lower bound for spatial error, and combine monotone output with uniform-grid discrepancy.

items.title: Finite-bit Box–Muller with certified elementary-function evaluators
items.strategy: Consume two disjoint midpoint streams, evaluate log/sqrt/trigonometric functions with explicit certificates, and return inconclusive on failed certification.

items.title: Certified finite-bit Box–Muller has explicit BL and W1 error
items.strategy: Split at U1≥δ, propagate radial/angular/evaluator errors, and bound the discarded event in BL and Wasserstein distance.

title: Finite bit random streams and variate generation — Examples

items.title: A full-period LCG can alternate its low bit
items.strategy: Compute the w=3 cycle and exhibit deterministic parity alternation despite uniform one-time marginals.

items.title: Eight-bit Box–Muller has a finite radial cutoff
items.strategy: Use the smallest midpoint 2^-9 to compute the exact maximal radius and omitted Rayleigh tail.

items.title: A raw zero uniform breaks Box–Muller but the midpoint avoids it
items.strategy: Compare a raw grid including zero with the b-bit midpoint grid and record the endpoint probabilities.

items.title: A vanishing density prevents a uniform spatial inverse bound
items.strategy: For F(x)=x^2, show CDF residual ε can correspond to spatial error √ε near zero.
